name: Door
intro: The Door pathway specializes in travel, spatial manipulation, sealing and escape. Its Beyonders excel at movement, recording powers and crossing supernatural boundaries.

meter.name: Records
meter.full: Replay at full strength from Sequence 6; retain the current record capacity

ability.name: Phase Slip
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Phase Slip — +8 percentage points Dodge. Passive.

ability.name: Elemental Spark
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Elemental Spark — Deals 130% INT Elemental damage (25% base DEF bypass); resistance uses the average of Fire, Water, Lightning and Frost; 35% chance to apply one of Freeze, Burn, Stunned for 1 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Astrological Trajectory
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Astrological Trajectory — Supports all living allies; +10 percentage points accuracy; +10 percentage points critical chance; +10 percentage points critical damage. Passive.

ability.name: Combat Record
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Combat Record — Witness enemy abilities from Sequence 6; keep one record at Sequence 6, four from Sequence 5. At 100 charge, replay one record at full strength, paying its original SP cost and cooldown.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. Pays the stored ability’s SP cost and cooldown.

ability.name: Blink Strike
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Blink Strike — Deals 160% INT Elemental damage (25% base DEF bypass); resistance uses the average of Fire, Water, Lightning and Frost; +20 percentage points critical damage on this cast; 100% chance: +40 percentage points Dodge for 1 turn; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 45 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Door of Concealment
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Door of Concealment — Deals 170% INT Spatial damage (25% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Silenced for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Spatial Concealment
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Spatial Concealment — 100% chance: avoids targeting and incoming damage for 1 turn; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 70 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Spatial Exile
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Spatial Exile — 100% chance: leaves targeting and cannot act for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Star Gate Tear
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Star Gate Tear — Targets all enemies; Deals 300% INT Elemental damage (25% base DEF bypass); resistance uses the average of Fire, Water, Lightning and Frost; Enemy ATK −25% for 2 turns; Enemy DEF −25% for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Conceptual Unseal & Seal
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Conceptual Unseal & Seal — Deals 400% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Removes current stat buffs, Guarded, Evade and shields; 100% chance: Silenced for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
